title: Q-GROW-AGENT-DIRECTORIES: GROW-5: prepare listings for agent directories and registries (dry run)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order (growth items first when the recent growth share is below target)
**Done check:** file:outreach/agent-directories.json
**Status:** closed

Owner directive 2026-11-12: product management is growth, not only bug fixes. Growth item: it adds a capability, a surface, a reader or a customer path.

Agents find tools through registries and directories (MCP registries, agent skill indexes, agent-to-agent marketplaces). List each one with its submission route, what it needs (server card URL, skills index URL, description), the packet for Ultrastable's /mcp endpoint, and its status. Publishing is outreach egress: it stays a dry run behind the existing outreach gate until the gate says live.
Paths: outreach/agent-directories.json, scripts/outreach.py.
Acceptance: every listed directory has a complete packet; none is sent while the gate is dry-run.
Metric moved: agent_hits_7d.

size: M

**Closing probe:** file:outreach/agent-directories.json and the stated metric measured after the change (keep only if the target moved and no guard worsened).

**Evidence:** closing probe passed (6 consecutive passes after a recorded failure): file:outreach/agent-directories.json
